key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) turns Policy Mirror Descent into a trajectory-level reinforcement learning objective for terminal-reward autoregressive generation, eliminating the need to estimate intermediate state values.
engineering_relevance: BPO offers a simpler critic-free training recipe for reasoning LLMs, which can reduce implementation complexity and avoid instability from value-function learning.
method: Use Bellman equations to rewrite PMD at the full-trajectory level for terminal rewards.
Optimize a practical BPO loss with a mismatch-correction weight based on a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities.
Preserve the same unique optimum as the original PMD objective while avoiding intermediate value estimation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, where BPO demonstrates effectiveness for improving reasoning performance.
watch_item: The practical loss relies on an approximation and a smoothed correction weight, so performance may depend on how well this surrogate matches the original Bellman-form objective.
